text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
It's that time of year again—the Satsuki Sho!
Show us a powerful run even at 2,000 meters, Tanino Gimlet!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text: "She looked great in the Shinzan Kinen, so I can't help having high hopes! I wanna see a flashy run!"

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
I wanna see her nail a 2000m race so bad~~!!
Uooh, can't it start already~~?!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Heh-heh.
I can hear it... the crowd calling my name...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even on such a momentous stage as the first leg of the Triple Crown,
Tanino Gimlet seems entirely unbothered as usual.
At this rate, she'll be able to fight at full power without any issues.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
—Naturally. Even the Satsuki Sho
is merely a passing point in my grand scenario.
There is no reason for my heart to be unsettled.
choice_data_list: (S-She read me like a book again...!)

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Still, this will by no means be an easy battle.
If anything, it's the toughest battlefield we've faced yet...!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Therefore, I dance!
I shall display my destruction to the mighty who walk this era!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: Now, it is time for Nakayama to tremble...!
choice_data_list: Show them what your running is made of!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Tanino Gimlet responded to my call silently, raising her right hand—

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Tanino Gimlet—!!
Show them you've got what it takes
at medium distance too—!!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
I'm rooting for youuu!
Do your best again todayyy!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
—Yes. Make your cheers ring louder.
As if to prove my very existence...!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Will this brilliant radiance burn away the crown, or not?!
Standing at the center of this frantic stage, the one to prove itâ
is me, Tanino Gimlet!!
